messages:
nina: Heads-up: HealthOrbit procurement requested a short POC: a 24h on-prem vuln scan (weekend preferred), plus a redacted ISO snippet and SOC2 summary for their security review. They also want a signed pen-test attestation. Can we scope? cc @omar @jess

omar: We can provide a redacted ISO excerpt and SOC2 summary. Pen-test attestation: security has a canned letter we can sign but sometimes legal asks for a minor redline.

jess: Ops note: weekend slot OK but we need 48h notice for any bastion. If Redwood runs the scan we need allowlist of two egress IPs and an SSO invite for the engineer. If the customer runs the scan, they can point it at staging and we provide sample creds.

infra-bot: HOSTED_SCANNER_IPS: 52.11.22.33, 52.11.22.34. Bastion fingerprint available on request.

nina: Procurement asked for Saturday 02:00-06:00 UTC. Is that workable? Also they asked if having Redwood run the scan adds to cost.

omar: Pricing: basic evidence exchange (SOC2 summary, redacted ISO) is included in POC. Hands-on scan facilitation or remediation time is billable. Estimate 3-5 engineer-hours; propose a $900 one-time ops fee. I'll note that in the quote.

jess: If they want us to run the scan we need: 1) completed ATO form, 2) SSO user for the engineer, 3) firewall allowlist for 52.11.22.33/34 at least 24h prior.

sec-bot: SECURITY: Pen-test attestation template path /compliance/attestations/pen_test_attest_v1.docx. Any network access also requires signed NDA if customer data is in scope.

nina: They also sent a security questionnaire (20 questions) asking about key rotation, KMS, and penetration testing cadence. Who owns answers?

omar: Send the questionnaire to me and I’ll fill tech answers. For legal/security-specific wording I’ll loop in sec-team.

jess: I can upload a redacted ISO snippet to Proofpack. We usually presign for 48h. Command I’ll use: aws s3 presign s3://proofpacks/healthorbit/ISO-redacted.zip --expires-in 172800

nina: Great. If we bill the $900 ops fee, procurement wants that called out as "POC scan facilitation" on the quote. Make sure to add a line that says "customer responsible for firewall changes".

omar: Will do. Also flag: if legal requests bespoke language on the pen-test attestation, that may add 2-4 days to turnaround.

sec-bot: NOTE: For signatures on attestation, require manager-level approval from security. Typical turnaround 1 business day after redline acceptance.

jess: Uploaded presign link (placeholder): https://redwood-proofs.s3.amazonaws.com/healthorbit/ISO-redacted-presign?token=X

nina: Thanks. Final checklist: 1) omar add $900 line and attach pen-test template to CRM, 2) jess post presign and proofpack link, 3) customer to confirm firewall allowlist for 52.11.22.33/34 and ATO form completion, 4) omar to populate sec questionnaire answers. I’ll follow up with procurement once the presign is live.

omar: Added quote line and attached attestation template to the opportunity.

nina: Closing loop—I’ll ping procurement and sync legal if they push any redlines. Thanks team :rocket:
